description: Plugin System SDK, Lifecycle Hooks, Capability Descriptors, and Sandboxing. Extend PluginEntity model with lifecycle hooks (onInstall, onActivate, onDeactivate, onUninstall), capability descriptors (requiredPermissions, supportedPlatforms, minVersion), and a sandboxing/permission model. Create a Plugin SDK specification document. Add backend validation of plugin permissions. Update frontend plugin pages to show SDK info and permissions.
steps: Extend src/Nexus.Gateway/Models/PluginEntity.cs with new fields: Version, MinGatewayVersion, RequiredCapabilities (JSON string list like 'filesystem', 'network', 'registry', 'activedirectory'), SandboxLevel ('full', 'restricted', 'minimal'), LifecycleHooks (JSON object with OnInstall, OnActivate, OnDeactivate, OnUninstall script content), DependsOn (comma-separated plugin IDs), ApiVersion string

Create src/Nexus.Gateway/Models/PluginManifest.cs with a PluginManifest class that defines the SDK contract: Id, Name, Description, Version, Author, ApiVersion, Capabilities (list of PluginCapability enum), Permissions (list of PluginPermission objects with Resource, Actions, Justification), LifecycleHooks (dictionary of hook name to script), EntryPoint, SandboxPolicy (enum: Unrestricted, Standard, Strict)

Create src/Nexus.Gateway/Services/PluginSandboxService.cs that validates plugin script content against its declared permissions before execution. If a plugin declares only 'filesystem' capability but tries to use network commands, block it. Validate against BlockedPatterns similar to PowerShellSessionManager but filtered by capability set.

Update src/Nexus.Gateway/Controllers/PluginsController.cs: add GET /api/plugins/{id}/manifest endpoint returning the plugin's manifest, add POST /api/plugins/{id}/validate endpoint that runs the sandbox validator on the script, add lifecycle hook execution in the run endpoint (call OnActivate before running, OnDeactivate after)
Update src/Nexus.Frontend/src/routes/plugin.$id.tsx to display plugin manifest info (capabilities, permissions, sandbox level, version, API version) in a new 'SDK Info' section

Create src/Nexus.Gateway/Docs/PLUGIN_SDK.md documenting the plugin contract: manifest format, lifecycle hooks, available capabilities, permission model, how to develop third-party plugins, sandboxing rules
acceptance_criteria: PluginEntity model has Version, RequiredCapabilities, SandboxLevel, LifecycleHooks fields
PluginManifest model exists with full SDK contract definition
PluginSandboxService validates script content against declared capabilities
Frontend plugin page shows SDK metadata section
PLUGIN_SDK.md documentation exists with complete developer guide
Frontend builds successfully with bun run build
verification: cd src/Nexus.Frontend && bun install && bun run build
